title: receiveTypingIndicators Chat/set on channel chat: accept-or-reject undefined
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md line 854 says the receiveTypingIndicators patch key is supported for all chat kinds. Line 856 says it applies to direct and group chats only. A Chat/set update that sets receiveTypingIndicators on a channel Chat has no defined server response: the spec does not say whether to accept silently (store-but-ignore), accept and discard, or reject with an error. Implementors will diverge. This must specify the normative behavior: either the field MUST NOT be accepted on channel chats (return invalidProperties) or it MUST be accepted and silently ignored.
close_reason: Fixed in review fix wave or recorded as accepted design decision.
